definition: ἀνα-στατόω, ῶ (ἀνάστατος, driven from home; ἀνίστημι), [in  LXX: Dan.7:23 (דּוּשׁ;* also in Aq., and in π. (see Deiss., LAE, 80 f.; MM, VGT, see word),] to stir up, excite, unsettle: with accusative;  __(a) to tumult and sedition: Act.17:6 21:38;  __(b) by false teaching: Gal.5:12 (see Milligan, NTD, 73 f.).† (AS)
